newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,580-1,590 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,580-1,590 to dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed flat on the opening at 1,580-1,590 per dollar on a calm interbank market where the central bank was seen buying foreign currency, dealers said.
"Trade was lively as there was higher interest in both dollar sales and purchases. Demand and supply met around 1,580-1,590," a dealer said.
Foreign currency supply came mainly from final clients aiming to boost lev liquidity in anticipation of a stable or a firmer lev.
The central bank was seen buying dollars through a large state-owned commercial bank, traders said. They did not elaborate.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
The lev traded stable between 1,550-1,650 this week, up from about 1,900 at the beginning of March. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
